notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
-Bug fixes.
-The book riddle has been replaced, you can now access the next room.
-Loading music has been modified.
-Interaction icons now correspond to keys.
-The digicode now displays all entrances.

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
- Bug fixes.
- Removal of activities that cannot be performed in the demo.
- Added golems. (explanations)
- You can now choose whether you want written puzzles.
- Aiming can now be reversed.
